## Summary

When pm-cli installs the published npm package pm-changelog@2026.5.24-1 and runs the pm-cli coverage gate, V8 reports sourcemap warnings for the package extension files:

```text
Sourcemap for ".../.agents/pm/extensions/pm-changelog/dist/extension.js" points to missing source files
Sourcemap for ".../.agents/pm/extensions/pm-changelog/dist/generator.js" points to missing source files
```

## Observed

The package works and `pm changelog generate` passes, but the published tarball includes source maps whose referenced source files are not present in the runtime package install.

## Expected

Published package sourcemaps should either resolve to included source files, use embedded sources, or be omitted from the runtime package so downstream coverage/release gates stay warning-free.

## Repro

From unbraind/pm-cli after installing pm-changelog@2026.5.24-1 through `pm install npm:pm-changelog --project`:

```bash
node scripts/release/run-gates.mjs --skip-dogfood --skip-telemetry-sentry --json
```

The gate passes, but coverage emits the warnings above.

## Notes

This is package-side packaging hygiene. pm-cli should continue using the published package as-is and should not patch package contents locally.

### GitHub comments (1)

> **@unbraind** (2026-05-24T00:12:57Z)
>
> Fixed in this commit: added `inlineSources: true` to `tsconfig.json` so all `dist/*.js.map` files now embed TypeScript source content via `sourcesContent`. V8 resolves sources from the embedded content instead of loading separate `.ts` files, eliminating the warning when the package is installed without the `src/` directory.\n\nVerified: 18/18 tests pass, `npm run release:check` passes, clean `pm install` + `pm package doctor --detail deep` in a temp folder confirms no warnings.
